apply.name: empty window keeps the server order, unsorted
empty array counts as an empty window
a full window re-sent changes nothing
gone for an id nobody holds is a no-op
a row in next AND in gone leaves
a bare-second timestamp sorts by instant, not by bytes
the same instant is broken by id
a duplicate id in one push keeps the last copy

fold.name: three frames held, then the window lands under them
frames onto nothing are the frames
a later frame overwrites an earlier version of the same row
a row reported gone in a held frame stays gone
a row that arrives and then leaves within the held frames

shed.name: the window slid forward by two
a row deleted from inside the window is not shed
the window jumped past everything held

absorb.name: every shed row is already held
shed rows land after the history already held
shed rows arrive out of order
a shed row older than the history held forces a full re-sort

orderSkew.note: merge-messages parses instants; use-older-pages compares ISO strings. They disagree here.
